item: {"addr": "0x14078a2d0", "comment": "From 1.6.1170, checked on 1.7.104 2026-11-23: our name. Lists high actors with !kInTempChangeList (+0xE8 & 0x200), !(form flags 0x200000), kProcessMe (+0xE8 & 2), a process, 3D with a parent and an attached cell, for 41370's animation jobs. An actor frozen with kProcessMe clear (EnableAI(false), the harness's FreezeActor) and killed gets no graph update: its death clip never reaches its Ragdoll event, its life state stays 1, and its ragdoll bodies stay keyframed at the last velocity driveToPose gave them, drifting (duo, body-rests-differently)."}

{"addr": "0x140687b40", "comment": "Actor::SetRestrained(actor, on), read 2026-11-23: on -> SetLifeState(6) and StopMoving; off -> SetLifeState(0) only while the life state (+0xC8 bits 21-24) is 6, so a dying (1) or dead (2) actor is left as it is (the harness thaws a frozen actor at its death)."}
